'''神別'''（しんべつ）とは、古代日本の氏族の分類の1つ。
[[平安時代]]初期に書かれた『[[新撰姓氏録]]』には、[[皇別]]・[[諸蕃]]と並んで、[[天津神]]・[[国津神]]の子孫を「神別」として記している（「天神地祇之冑、謂之神別」）。更に神別は「天神・天孫・地祇」に分類され、天神265・天孫109・地祇30を数える。なお、こうした区分は古くからあったらしく、これは[[律令制]]以前の[[カバネ|姓]]のうち、「臣」が皇別氏族に、「連」が神別氏族に集中していることから推測されている。
== 参考文献 == *阿部武彦「神別」（『国史大辞典 7』（吉川弘文館、1986年） ISBN 978-4-642-00507-4） *菊地照夫「神別」（『日本古代史大辞典 <small>旧石器時代～鎌倉幕府成立頃</small>』（大和書房、2006年） ISBN 978-4-479-84065-7）
{{Japanese-history-stub}}

revision.comment: 天孫と天神の順番間違いを訂正。天孫である皇室より、天神である中臣(藤原)氏が上位なのはおかしい。天孫の意味は天津神の天孫族であり、天孫降臨の意味ではないためリンク修正。

[[Category:神別]] [[Category:Original pages]][[ja:神別]] '''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[ancient]] [[Japanese]] clans.
The {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録}}, compiled in the early [[Heian period]], categorized clans as belonging to the [[Imperial lineage (Kōbetsu)|Imperial Lineage]] (皇別), [[Foreign Lineage (Shobetsu)|Foreign Lineage]] (諸蕃), or "'''Shinbetsu'''," the descendants of the [[Heavenly and Earthly Deities]] (天津神・国津神). The text notes, "Descendants of the Heavenly and Earthly Deities are called Shinbetsu" (天神地祇之冑、謂之神別).
Shinbetsu clans are further divided into three groups: "'''Tenson'''" (Heavenly Descendants), "'''Tenjin'''" (Heavenly Deities), and "'''Chigi'''" (Earthly Deities). The Shinsen Shōjiroku lists 109 Tenson clans, 265 Tenjin clans, and 30 Chigi clans. This classification appears to predate the [[Ritsuryō system]], as the earlier allocation of [[Kabane|titles]] like "'''Omī'''" to [[Imperial clans]] and "'''Muraji'''" to Shinbetsu clans suggests a long-standing distinction.
== Related Topics == * {{ill|Ancestral Deities#Main clans and corresponding deities|ja|祖神#主な氏族と祖神の対応}}

[[Category:神別]] [[Category:Original pages]][[ja:神別]] '''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[ancient]] [[Japanese]] clans.
The {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録}}, compiled in the early [[Heian period]], categorized clans as belonging to the [[Imperial lineage (Kōbetsu)|Imperial Lineage]] (皇別), [[Foreign Lineage (Shobetsu)|Foreign Lineage]] (諸蕃), or "'''Shinbetsu'''," the descendants of the [[Heavenly and Earthly Deities]] (天津神・国津神). The text notes, "Descendants of the Heavenly and Earthly Deities are called Shinbetsu" (天神地祇之冑、謂之神別).
Shinbetsu clans are further divided into three groups: "'''Tenson'''" (Heavenly Descendants), "'''Tenjin'''" (Heavenly Deities), and "'''Chigi'''" (Earthly Deities). The Shinsen Shōjiroku lists 109 Tenson clans, 265 Tenjin clans, and 30 Chigi clans. This classification appears to predate the [[Ritsuryō system]], as the earlier allocation of [[Kabane|titles]] like "'''Omī'''" to [[Imperial clans]] and "'''Muraji'''" to Shinbetsu clans suggests a long-standing distinction.

The {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録}}, compiled in the early [[Heian period]], categorized clans as belonging to the [[Imperial lineage (Kōbetsu)|Imperial Lineage]] (皇別), [[Foreign Lineage (Shobetsu)|Foreign Lineage]] (諸蕃), or "'''Shinbetsu'''," the descendants of the [[Heavenly and Earthly Deities]] (天津神・国津神). The text notes, "Descendants of the Heavenly and Earthly Deities are called Shinbetsu" (天神地祇之冑、謂之神別).
Shinbetsu clans are further divided into three groups: "'''Tenson'''" (Heavenly Descendants), "'''Tenjin'''" (Heavenly Deities), and "'''Chigi'''" (Earthly Deities). The Shinsen Shōjiroku lists 109 Tenson clans, 265 Tenjin clans, and 30 Chigi clans. This classification appears to predate the [[Ritsuryō system]], as the earlier allocation of [[Kabane|titles]] like "'''Omī'''" to [[Imperial clans]] and "'''Muraji'''" to Shinbetsu clans suggests a long-standing distinction.

The {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録}}, compiled in the early [[Heian period]], categorized clans as belonging to the [[Imperial lineage (Kōbetsu)|Imperial Lineage]] (皇別), [[Foreign Lineage (Shobetsu)|Foreign Lineage]] (諸蕃), or "'''Shinbetsu'''," the descendants of the [[Heavenly and Earthly Deities]] (天津神・国津神). The text notes, "Descendants of the Heavenly and Earthly Deities are called Shinbetsu" (天神地祇之冑、謂之神別).
Shinbetsu clans are further divided into three groups: "'''Tenson'''" (Heavenly Descendants), "'''Tenjin'''" (Heavenly Deities), and "'''Chigi'''" (Earthly Deities). The Shinsen Shōjiroku lists 109 Tenson clans, 265 Tenjin clans, and 30 Chigi clans. This classification appears to predate the [[Ritsuryō system]], as the earlier allocation of [[Kabane|titles]] like "'''Omī'''" to [[Imperial clans]] and "'''Muraji'''" to Shinbetsu clans suggests a long-standing distinction.

'''神別'''（しんべつ）とは、[[古代]][[日本]]の[[氏族]]の分類の1つ。
[[平安時代]]初期に書かれた『[[新撰姓氏録]]』には、[[皇別]]・[[諸蕃]]と並んで、[[天津神・国津神]]の子孫を「'''神別'''」として記している（「天神地祇之冑、謂之神別」）。さらに神別は「[[天孫]]」・「[[天津神・国津神|天神]]」・「[[天津神・国津神|地祇]]」に分類され、天孫109・天神265・地祇30を数える。なお、こうした区分は古くからあったらしく、これは[[律令制]]以前の[[カバネ|姓]]のうち、「[[臣]]」が[[皇別]][[氏族]]に、「[[連]]」が神別氏族に集中していることから推測されている。
== 関連項目 == * [[祖神#主な氏族と祖神の対応]]
== 参考文献 == * 阿部武彦「神別」（『国史大辞典 7』（[[吉川弘文館]]、[[1986年]]） ISBN 978-4-642-00507-4） * 菊地照夫「神別」（『日本古代史大辞典 <small>旧石器時代～鎌倉幕府成立頃</small>』（[[大和書房]]、[[2006年]]） ISBN 978-4-479-84065-7）
{{DEFAULTSORT:しんへつ}} {{Japanese-history-stub}} [[Category:日本の氏族]] [[Category:飛鳥時代]] [[Category:奈良時代]] [[Category:平安時代]] [[Category:日本神話]]

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[ja:神別]][[ko:신별]]
{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[d:Q11588768]]
Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:21, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}}
{{afc comment|1=I am exhausted by the sorting, is anyone else interested in sorting it?[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 21:22, 30 March 2025 (UTC)}}
{{afc comment|1=There does not seem to be a comprehensive list on japanese wikipedia, or anywhere so compiling the list from different sources[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:27, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}}

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|qq=|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|qq=|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

{{afc comment|1=There does not seem to be a comprehensive list on japanese wikipedia, or anywhere so compiling the list from different sources[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:27, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}}

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[Category:Has wikidata]][[da:d:Q11588768]]
Wikidata name: [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:21, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}}
{{afc comment|1=I am exhausted by the sorting, is anyone else interested in sorting it?[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 21:22, 30 March 2025 (UTC)}}
{{afc comment|1=There does not seem to be a comprehensive list on japanese wikipedia, or anywhere so compiling the list from different sources[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:27, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}}

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of [[:en:Ancient history|Ancient history]] [[:en:Japan|Japan]]'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''[[:en:Shinsen Shōjiroku|Shinsen Shōjiroku]]'' compiled during the [[:en:Heian period|Heian period]] describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''[[:en:Omi (title)|Omi]]'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''[[:en:Muraji|Muraji]]'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''[[:en:Fujiwara clan|Fujiwara clan]]''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.
