'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history|1=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku|1=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period|1=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi|1=Omi (title)}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji|1=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan|1=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history|1=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku|1=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period|1=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi|1=Omi (title)}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji|1=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan|1=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.

'''Shinbetsu''' (神別) refers to one of the classifications of {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|WD=Q41493|lt=Ancient history|1=Ancient history}} {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|WD=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}'s [[Uji (clan)|clans]].

The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|WD=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku|1=Shinsen Shōjiroku}}'' compiled during the {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|WD=Q193292|lt=Heian period|1=Heian period}} describes Shinbetsu alongside ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' and ''{{ill|Shoban|ja|諸蕃|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shoban|qq=}}'', identifying the descendants of ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|国津神|1=Kunitsukami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'' as "Shinbetsu" ("天神地祇之冑、謂之神別"). Furthermore, Shinbetsu is categorized into ''{{ill|Tenson|ja|天孫|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenson|1=Posterity of Heaven|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q108278353}}'', ''{{ill|Amatsukami|ja|天津神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/matsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ|comment=confirming this goes to Amatsukami|1=Amatsukami|2=zh|3=天神 (日本神話)|4=fr|5=Amatsukami|6=mni|7=ꯑꯃꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', and ''{{ill|Kunitsukami|ja|地祇|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunitsukami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天津神・国津神|comment=confirming this goes to Kunitsukami|1=Kunitsukami|2=zh|3=國神|4=fr|5=Kunitsukami|6=mni|7=ꯀꯨꯅꯤꯠꯁꯨꯀꯃꯤ}}'', with Tenson accounting for 109, Amatsukami for 265, and Kunitsukami for 30 entries. These classifications are thought to have ancient origins, as inferred from the concentration of ''{{ill|Omi (title)|en|Omi (title)|WD=Q2574718|lt=Omi|1=Omi (title)}}'' titles among ''{{ill|Kōbetsu|ja|皇別|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōbetsu|qq=}}'' clans and ''{{ill|Muraji|en|Muraji|WD=Q2735611|lt=Muraji|1=Muraji}}'' titles among Shinbetsu clans under the pre-[[Ritsuryō system]].

The ancestral deity of a shinbetsu clan is their [[Oyagami]] and will also be an [[Ujigami]] although some clans may have other Ujigami such as the '''{{ill|Fujiwara clan|en|Fujiwara clan|WD=Q641628|lt=Fujiwara clan|1=Fujiwara clan}}''' whose three Oyagami are [[Ame-no-Koyane]], [[Himegami]] and {{ill|Ame-no-Oshikumone|ja|天押雲根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Oshikumone|qq=}}, however the two are worshipped alongside two non-ancestral Ujigami: [[Takemikazuchi]]-o, and [[Futsunushi]]. The five are merged together into the composite deity {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|ja|春日神|1=Kasuga-no-Kami|2=ja|3=春日神|4=fr|5=Kasuga no Kami|6=zh|7=春日權現|8=wuu|9=春日權現|fr|Kasuga_no_Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Kasuga-no-Kami|qq=}} worshipped at [[Kasuga-taisha]] and many other Kasuga shrines nationwide.
